entry.title: Passport Stamp Animation
entry.learningObjective: Certify completion of the tasting journey with a real Passport stamp record.
entry.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package E (SC-D067): fixed a real backward/unreachable sequencing defect — REQUIRED_STEPS previously included Session 24 (final-review), which comes AFTER Session 23 in route order, making first-time eligibility impossible on a normal visit; removed. Fixed missing server authority — eligibility/claim previously trusted a client-submitted completedSteps array and scorecardId; now reads the caller's own real smokecraft_session_completions via playerStateService.getPlayerState, never a client-supplied value. The session's own generic completion is now additionally gated on real, server-recorded Passport stamp evidence (hasPassportStampEvidence, same additive pattern as Packages A/B/C) so it can never complete from a route visit alone. The silent auto-claim effect was replaced with an explicit "Claim Your Stamp" button requiring a real player click, disabled until server-verified eligible. Reuses the existing canonical Passport-360 stamp system (claimJourneyCompletionStamp/getStamps, real dedupe_key idempotency) — no second Passport/rewards system created. Verified end-to-end via API and real-browser tests, including cross-player denial, concurrency, duplicate-claim, and reload persistence.
